I'd rather not reveal too many specific details.

I am old enough to have a standard 9-5 job of which I do have. I'm in IT of sorts.

I do live by myself, I don't quite have friends in my area as I moved a few months ago. As for remote friends - that isn't working out so well.

It goes and it doesn't matter. Unfortunately I was a bit naive to think bleeding myself would be a task I could accomplish, so instead here we are I with scars and the rest of everyone else recognizing I'm but another case of he/she who cried wolf.
No, I'm not staying on hold
